title: Search for 100% stoneware renders error page
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "A results page is shown with a heading that includes "100% stoneware"."

verdict.title: Search for 100% stoneware renders error page
verdict.oneLiner: Searching for “100% stoneware” shows an error page instead of a results page.
verdict.rootCause: The search page could not display results for the requested search term and showed an error message instead.
verdict.suggestion: Investigate why the search route for “100% stoneware” enters the error state. Ensure it shows a heading containing the query and either matching products or a no-results message.
